kaggle.title: DeepFashion_In-shop_Clothes_Retrieval_Adjusted
kaggle.description_transform: Re-organized into images/masks, images without masks discarded, three-channel masks reduced to one channel.
kaggle.provenance_conclusion: Verified as the content package of Kaggle version 1 by exact total uncompressed byte count, exact pair/member counts, matching leading paths and matching file sizes. Kaggle does not publish a package SHA-256 in the API response.

verified_transformations: Deletes images without a matching mask.
Flattens gender/category/original item hierarchy into numeric IDs starting at 1000.
Builds the ID map from list(set(...)); the mapping is not persisted.
Retains only the first two underscore-separated view tokens in the image filename.
Maps 16 RGB tuples to integer IDs 0..15 and saves single-channel PNG masks.

mask_schema_sources.rgb_to_id: Directly verified from the publisher's generate_masks.py.
mask_schema_sources.semantic_conflict: MMFashion's In-shop table assigns several shared RGB colors to different semantic names than the actual archive regions. The paper code names RGB(16,78,139) face, RGB(255,0,0) hair and RGB(144,238,144) skin; those map to archive IDs 4,9,14 and agree with the archive atlas. StyleGAN-Human independently documents the same color meanings and also maps RGB(211,211,211) to pants and RGB(245,222,179) to shoes, agreeing with archive IDs 13 and 15. No archive-publisher semantic-name table was found.

paper_and_code.version_warning: The local copy is the post-paper 2025-11-04 main revision. At paper publication, the latest commit was 2025-04-28 and had defaults 15 users, 3 purchases, Top-10, w_v=0.4, w_p=0.2 and gamma=4; current main changed the first five values toward the paper but retained gamma=4.

limits: The original DeepFashion archive referenced by the conversion project was not downloaded.
The conversion script did not save its numeric-ID-to-original-path dictionary, so an exact reverse mapping cannot be reconstructed from the adjusted archive alone.
No standalone semantic-name table published specifically for the Kaggle adjusted archive was found.
